title: Packages marked delivered by carriers but not received by customers
situation: Customers report missing orders marked as delivered by carriers, requiring immediate investigation and reshipment or carrier check before the delivery complaint window closes.
hypothesis: Carrier marked packages delivered prematurely without drop-off

params.reply_en: We see your order was marked as delivered, but we understand you have not received it. We are checking with the courier right now and will arrange a replacement shipment for you.
params.reply_ar: نرى أن طلبك قد تم تحديثه كمرسل، ولكننا ندرك أنك لم تستلمه. نحن نتحقق من الشركة الناعلة الآن وسنقوم بترتيب شحنة بديلة لك.

actions.why: Acknowledge the missing delivery status and inform customers of the active investigation and replacement.

params.reason: Carrier marked delivered but customer did not receive

actions.why: Send a free replacement shipment for the missing orders.

params.title: Package marked delivered but not received
params.answer_en: If your tracking shows delivered but you have not received your package, please wait 24 hours in case it was marked early, or contact us to arrange a replacement.
params.answer_ar: إذا أظهر التتبع أن طلبك تم تسليمه ولكنك لم تستلمه، يرجى الانتظار 24 ساعة تحسباً لتحديثه مبكراً، أو التواصل معنا لتنظيم شحنة بديلة.

actions.why: Prevent future repeat inquiries about carrier false delivery statuses.

reply_en: We see your order was marked as delivered, but we understand you have not received it. We are checking with the courier right now and will arrange a replacement shipment for you.
reply_ar: نرى أن طلبك قد تم تحديثه كمرسل، ولكننا ندرك أنك لم تستلمه. نحن نتحقق من الشركة الناعلة الآن وسنقوم بترتيب شحنة بديلة لك.

reply_other.fr: Nous voyons que votre commande a été marquée comme livrée, mais nous comprenons que vous ne l'avez pas reçue. Nous vérifions auprès du transporteur et organiserons un nouvel envoi.
reply_other.es: Vemos que tu pedido aparece como entregado pero no lo has recibido. Estamos revisando con el transportista y organizaremos un nuevo envío.

alternatives.why: Customers might have old delivery addresses selected on their accounts.
Packages marked delivered could be taken from doorsteps after courier left.
